public_source.title: A subspace code of size 333 in the setting of a binary q-analog of the Fano plane
public_source.version: arXiv v5 dated 2019-03-22; first arXiv version dated 2017-08-21; journal version 2019
public_source.construction_method: The paper reports an integer-linear-programming search and prints the orbit representatives and G_{4,6} generators.
public_source.ai_provenance: Not reported in the source; do not describe the result as unaided hand construction.

source.title: A subspace code of size 333 in the setting of a binary q-analog of the Fano plane
source.claim: Explicit same-parameter lower-bound construction of size 333; this is not an optimum claim.

upper_bound_claims.derivation: There are [7 choose 2]_2=2667 two-dimensional subspaces, each 3-space contains [3 choose 2]_2=7, and no 2-space can occur in two codewords; floor(2667/7)=381.

upper_bound_claims.version: 2025 survey, section on the binary q-analog of the Fano plane

current_status_check.result: The live MIPLIB instance retains 333 as the lower bound and 381 as the upper bound. The 2025 Kurz survey gives the conditional 378-or-381 alternative. No later exact optimum or 381-code proof was located in this check. The live specialist table endpoint returned a gateway error. This is a bounded source check, not a proof that no later result exists.

limitations: The witness proves a lower bound of 333, not optimality.
The conditional 378-or-381 result does not give an unconditional upper bound of 378.
No 381-subspace code or proof of nonexistence was found in the checked sources.

best_human.provenance: Heinlein, Kiermaier, Kurz, and Wassermann report an integer-linear-programming search and print the 333-subspace construction. AI provenance is not reported.
best_human.evidence_state: witness reconstructed from Appendix B/C and independently checked exactly

best_public.evidence_state: same-parameter published construction; witness independently replayed

best_reproduced.provenance: Parsed the Appendix C RREF representatives, decoded each column digit as a+2b+4c, and applied the Appendix B G_{4,6} group action.
best_reproduced.ai_provenance: The paper reports an ILP-based search. It does not state whether AI tools were used; no unaided-human claim is made.
best_reproduced.evidence_state: all 333 row spaces and 55,278 pairwise intersections checked exactly over GF(2)
